analysis:
All three changed files are documentation only (docs/architecture/inference.md, model-registry.md, prefix-cache.md). No source, config or deployment changes are present, so no control regressions are evidenced.

prefix-cache.md (head lines ~129-153): adds an unregistered GLM sparse-state candidate. It states that SSD prefix-cache eligibility defaults on for the locally selected EigenLabs/GLM-5.3-Flash-MLX-NVFP4-mtp via PrefixCachePolicy.isGLM5NextDefaultModel. DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 opts out, and GLM stays outside the registered coordinator serving models. The stated gates are the protected native binding, verified encrypted restore and charged ownership. This falls under T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache TTFT oracle, SEC-035 accepted risk). T-041 already covers default-on SSD for eligible CBv2 models with HMAC names, a 30-minute TTL and account-scoped cacheSalt. The code that implements the GLM default (PrefixCachePolicy+Activation.swift, GLM5Next codec) is not in the supplied evidence. The next pass should confirm that it keeps the same KEK/HMAC lookup, salt scoping, TTL and per-donation gating, and that the new layout native-paged-glm5next-full-state-v1 adds no plaintext prompt-derived metadata. Because GLM is local-only and not coordinator-registered, cacheSalt scoping may not apply. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. A T-041 note listing GLM as a default-on model may be warranted if the code lands.

model-registry.md (head 22-26): documents bounded GLM discovery quotation with no loadable fallback for a malformed inventory. It says these checks do not replace catalog/source identity or native validation. This is consistent with A-004/T-012/T-027 and adds no new trust claim.

inference.md (head 1207-1505, patch excerpt truncated): MiMo audio and tool-schema restoration, decode memory accounting, Flash-Next and GLM tool-suffix validation. Everything is presented as reduced or fail-closed: reserved schema metadata is rejected, memory charges and limits remain mandatory, GLM malformed suffixes fail before publication, and no tool, media or memory-admission bypass is granted. No contradiction with T-007, T-010, T-029 or T-050 is visible. The earlier portion of the file (base 662-692, head 71-310 and 902-959) was not supplied in a numbered unit, so I could not review it.
